result.title: ReactDrive: Self-Reactive Driving World Model
result.summary: The world evolves through the dynamics of its constituent entities and their interactions, with changes in one entity influencing the behavior of others. To simulate this evolution under different actions, interactive world models need to capture the resulting agent responses as part of the world's own dynamics. In autonomous driving, errors in modeling these responses can misrepresent maneuver safety and undermine the reliability of generated videos used for policy evaluation and learning. To formalize this intrinsic requirement for driving world model, we define self-reactivity as the capability to model agent responses from observed history and a specified ego action, and generate visual futures that reflect those responses without prescribed future agent trajectories. To realize this capability, we introduce ReactDrive, a driving world model that jointly learns agent dynamics and visual generation through a shared agent state representation. Within this framework, dynamics supervision grounds a reactive dynamics prior in observed agent states, while the video objective jointly optimizes the self-reactivity and visual realism. Experiments show improved agent responses, ego controllability, and video quality, a 96.0% preference for agent reactivity in human comparisons across five baselines, and better downstream planning through augmentation with generated videos. We hope this work encourages the community to recognize self-reactivityas a foundational capability for developing and evaluating interactive world models. Project page: https://reactdrive.github.io/ .

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向自动驾驶提出 ReactDrive 世界模型，定义「自我反应性」——仅由观测历史和给定的 ego 动作推演其他交通参与者的响应并生成相应视觉未来，方法上让动力学学习与视频生成共享同一 agent 状态表示，并以动力学监督把反应先验锚定在观测状态上。
AI.relevance_reason: 共享 agent 状态作为可监督的中间表示驱动后续视觉生成，与 LVR 中「推理状态承载任务必要实体关系、并需核查其对输出的实际贡献」问题结构相似，可供核查该状态是否真被生成使用；但它不涉及多模态推理与 latent 推理轨迹，迁移性有限。
